concerns.analysis: The source PDF contains several meaningful images that have been omitted from the HTML output. Notably, the NCDIT agency logo at the top left of page 4 is missing entirely from the HTML. Furthermore, on page 1, the speech bubble containing the text 'OUR FAVORITE SUPER HEROES WEAR HEADSETS!' is completely absent from the output, losing meaningful visual content.
concerns.source_pdf_quote: The NCDIT logo on page 4 and the speech bubble reading 'OUR FAVORITE SUPER HEROES WEAR HEADSETS!' on page 1.
concerns.output_quote: The HTML lacks any element corresponding to the NCDIT logo or the speech bubble.

concerns.analysis: On page 23, the text content recounting a story about a telecommunicator is presented twice: once embedded as an image (described in the alt text as 'Two columns of text recount a story about a man named Tim...') and then immediately followed by the exact same extracted text structured in HTML paragraphs. This forces the user to encounter the same block of information twice.
concerns.source_pdf_quote: Two columns of text starting with 'As a Telecommunicator, you typically have a servant's heart...'
concerns.output_quote:
followed by

Answering the Call at 30,000 Feet

As a Telecommunicator...

concerns.description: Output has more images than source PDF (ratio 1.1x) — possible image duplication
concerns.analysis: image_count_ratio=1.14. More images in output than in source indicates duplicated or fabricated image elements.
